name: uma-build-advisor
description: Repository-grounded Umamusume build advice with a ChatGPT build view and private inventory tools.

interface.longDescription: Plan server-specific Umamusume builds in ChatGPT Web chat from the versioned Japanese or Global game-data catalog and your private inventory. Connect the local MCP server through OpenAI Secure MCP Tunnel for private data access and updates. Includes fresh strategy research, six-card deck recommendations, legacy candidates, substitutions, and an interactive recommendation view.
interface.defaultPrompt: Help me plan a Japanese-server Umamusume build using my catalog and inventory.
